profile_text.body:
Shopify Inc. describes itself as an all-in-one commerce platform for businesses. Its website says it offers more than ecommerce software, with tools to manage every part of a business, and that users can build or grow a business fast with AI. The site also describes a feature called Agentic Storefronts, through which shoppers check out in chat and businesses are discovered across AI channels.

Shopify Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Ottawa. It trades under the ticker SHOP and has SEC Central Index Key 0001594805. The company is also listed under the alias SHOPIFY INC - CLASS A.
